name: Indirect Tree Specification via Subsystem Reconciliation
description: I removed the explicit explanation that the network is a "minimal basis" where removing one edge breaks connectivity. Instead, I state only that the full set reconciles the entire system and that `m = n - 1`. The model must independently deduce that this implies a unique path between any two nodes and thus a unique minimal subtree spanning the priority nodes. I also reframed the problem from "deducing offsets" to "reconciling protein variants via reversible reactions", changing the semantic domain to biochemistry to disrupt pattern matching on calibration tasks.
